android.label: Android
android.status: WebView wrapper shared with the canonical UI; APK build is verified, hardware bridge and QuantT telemetry are not

ios.label: iOS
ios.build: cd apple && xcodegen generate && xcodebuild -scheme BeeHive-iOS
ios.status: SwiftUI shell plus bundled web UI; simulator build is the verification boundary

macos.label: macOS
macos.build: cd apple && xcodegen generate && xcodebuild -scheme BeeHive-macOS
macos.status: SwiftUI shell plus bundled web UI and CLI; local graph, codec and QuantT build, device run unverified

linux.label: Linux
linux.status: Loopback browser host; no native toolkit UI

ayeos.label: AyeOS
ayeos.status: Loopback browser host service; not yet run on ayeOS hardware

web.label: Web
web.status: Canonical UI; QuantT is a relative Wi-Fi fingerprint estimate, not GPS; optional device APIs require permissions
